name: austropromo
description: Cinematic AustroClash promotional video production with Remotion.

scripts.render: npm run ensure:out && node scripts/remotion.mjs render src/index.ts AustroClashShort out/austroclash-short.mp4 --codec=h264 --pixel-format=yuv420p --color-space=bt709 --crf=18 --concurrency=2 --log=error
scripts.render:short: npm run ensure:out && node scripts/remotion.mjs render src/index.ts AustroClashShort out/austroclash-short-test.mp4 --frames=0-59 --codec=h264 --pixel-format=yuv420p --color-space=bt709 --crf=18 --concurrency=2 --log=error
scripts.test-frame: npm run ensure:out && node scripts/remotion.mjs still src/index.ts AustroClashShort out/test-frame.png --frame=900 --log=error
